name: kxgreenland
title: Will Trump buy at least part of Greenland?
settlement: If the United States purchases at least part of Greenland from Denmark before Jan 1, 2027, the market resolves to Yes. A separate market uses the later deadline of January 20, 2029.
decideContext: Estimate how a news item shifts the probability, in percentage points, that the US completes a purchase of at least part of Greenland from Denmark before the deadline. The market resolves Yes only on an actual completed purchase, not on talks, offers or rhetoric.
